RHOB.label: Bulk density
RHOB.note: Samples with a density correction above 0.1 g/cm³ removed as bad hole.

PHID.label: Density porosity
PHID.note: From bulk density with a quartz matrix of 2.65 g/cm³ and water of 1.0 g/cm³.

DRILL.label: Drilling time
DRILL.note: Minutes to drill one meter: a drilling parameter that also depends on the bit, weight on bit and rotation speed.

TEMP.label: Temperature
TEMP.note: Cased-hole log run shortly after drilling, so not at equilibrium temperature.
